title: Ostmann’s inverse Goldbach conjecture

result.label: Ostmann’s inverse Goldbach conjecture
result.statement: Proves that no finite modification of the primes can be written as A+B with A,B Z 0 each containing at least two elements. This resolves Ostmann's inverse Goldbach conjecture on additive indecomposability.
